Spot-checked claims point to exact inspected official pages/sections. Claims marked partially_documented or unknown remain qualified. Public docs are not treated as tested compatibility, enabled-account proof, or complete product coverage.

source_spot_checks.checked: Square US Support Bitcoin payment article and linked sections
source_spot_checks.finding: Supports Lightning QR payments; buyer-initiated/NFC is limited to Square Register (2nd generation); eligibility is US-specific with New York excluded; caps are $600 transaction equivalent/$20,000 daily; >5 minute payment requires a new cart/quote; manual completion is seller-risk; Bitcoin refunds use store gift cards.

source_spot_checks.checked: Current Bitcoin wallet help and terms
source_spot_checks.finding: The apparent custody ambiguity is resolved: Square/Block is custodian of bitcoin in its wallet; after withdrawal the seller controls the external wallet. Settlement-to-Bitcoin vs USD is a separate choice; withdrawals have limits/screening.

Confirms separate staff permissions, amount ceiling by original tender, custom-method refund constraints, in-progress admin return blocker, third-party fulfillment restock limit, unverified return, and split-refund workflow.

Cash/manual payment works offline; offline cards are conditional and remain uncaptured until reconnect. Returns/exchanges/voids, tips, gift cards, BOPIS, ship-to-customer and code/automatic discounts are offline-limited; power-off/logout risks offline orders.
Confirms permission gates, eligible/ineligible tenders, POS-only cash, cash-drawer reporting dependency, card one-refund/90-day limit, and same-day pre-settlement void.

Confirms distinct item/service-charge, full-check, tip-only, tax-only and custom refund types; fractional quantities; multiple-payment allocation; comments in refund reports; POS-only cash; web receipt limitation.

Distinguishes voiding checks, items and successful payments. A check with applied payment must have payment removed before void; item/check voids have kitchen/report consequences. Do not collapse void and refund behavior.
Refund is a customer claim followed by merchant payout approval, signing/broadcast and on-chain confirmation; it is not an automatic payment reversal.

Default Bitcoin LND archive keeps wallet/static channel backup but excludes channel graph; planned migration includes channel data and intentionally leaves source stopped. Other implementations require their own recovery procedures.

Means official public documentation describes a behavior. It does not establish tested compatibility, account activation, contract entitlement, live production behavior, or exhaustive branch coverage.

completion_scope_statement: This audit records a bounded first-party public-documentation corpus v1: eight POS vendor bundles, a separate card-component population, and a separate Bitcoin-native requirements population. It does not establish all capabilities of Square POS, Shopify POS, Toast, BTCPay Server, Stripe Terminal, or Bitcoin payment protocols, and it makes no whole-product feature-parity or absence claim. The current OpenBMT implementation mapping is undergoing correction for false-positive keyword matches and is a separate workstream; this source audit is not a software parity audit. The remaining unresolved and excluded entries are explicit research boundaries, not evidence that capabilities do not exist. Regional, plan, device, hardware, contract, version, host, and plugin qualifiers remain material wherever stated.

coordinator_mapping_review.rule: Prototype or scoped status requires the claimed central merchant action to have precise related implementation evidence. Category or vocabulary similarity alone receives not_assessed, with boundary evidence retained. No source claim is certified as parity.
coordinator_mapping_review.additional_checks: Reviewed legacy adapter/location mismatches, refund request versus payout, receipt projection versus delivery, restaurant checks, invoice query/setup, and the actual Square Sandbox read-only ListPayments reconciliation path.
